Metadata.title: Elmanian hypnosis training in Switzerland | mhp-coaching
Metadata.description: Hypnosis training in Fribourg: the OMNI® curriculum, advanced study, medical hypnosis and practical workshops.

HomePage.title: Elmanian hypnosis training, taught with calm precision.
HomePage.intro: mhp-coaching offers contemporary, direct, solution-focused hypnosis in Fribourg — taught with precision in a professional setting.
HomePage.aboutTitle: A school for people who will actually practise.
HomePage.aboutBody: Founded by Marta Hegyaljai Python, mhp-coaching brings the OMNI method into French and German-speaking practice. Groups stay small. Teaching stays practical. Recognition (ASCA, NGH, APSH, eduQua) supports a serious professional path — without turning the website into a diploma factory.
HomePage.coursesIntro: Start with the OMNI® curriculum, then deepen your practice through advanced modules and medical hypnosis. Upcoming dates are shown on each course.
HomePage.whyRapidBody: Inductions are designed to reach a useful depth quickly, with tests you can actually use in the room.
HomePage.whyPracticeBody: Groups are limited to sixteen people, with an instructor and assistants, so practice is supervised rather than theoretical.
HomePage.whyNetworkBody: OMNI has taught Elmanian hypnosis since 1979. The practitioner training is the door into that community and its certifications.
HomePage.coursesMore: You are seeing {shown} of {count}: the catalogue also covers advanced modules, medical hypnosis and practical workshops.
